principles.rule: No project branding, data, media, settings, orders, or authority may bleed across vessel boundaries.
principles.origin: cross-project flash and wrong-project admin regressions

principles.rule: Every startup and route-resolution shield must resolve within a bounded interval or transition to explicit safe recovery.
Operational navigation uses deterministic in-app routes; browser Back is not an operating control.
Every vessel must preserve a durable owner/partner control path independent of Black Flag.
Test, Sea Trial and Private Preview cannot trigger live phone, mail or SMS actions.
Customer production previews must represent the geometry the production process will use; no unsupported fallback geometry.
A customer-approved production artifact remains immutable through review, confirmation, owner/admin and archive.
Refresh preserves the correct authority, project and route when safe; refresh is recovery, not navigation.
Consequential actions leave readable transient feedback plus a durable visible result.
Operational command surfaces are complete in Professional View; Cinematic View is optional presentation and cannot be an operating dependency.
